Beyond that, the entry flags GDPR-compliant, governance and dependency notes rather than technical specifications. Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to cognigy.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about Cognigy's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
Cognigy is headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany, and its website presents the business as NiCE Cognigy, which it says powers enterprise customer service with generative and conversational AI agents across voice and chat. The site invites visitors to request a demo or try the product free, and it markets the deployment of AI agents in contact centers to deliver what it describes as fast, personalized service.

The company's tracked product is the Cognigy platform, listed under enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration and described as a conversational AI platform for customer service that is GDPR-compliant and offers EU-hosted options.

A litigation record for the company lists 25 cases in Delaware.
